name: threadpacket
description: Threadpacket sends a packet from one person's AI assistant to another person's assistant: a brief of the work so far, with the original files. Hosted at threadpacket.com, or on your own private server.

interface.longDescription:
Threadpacket sends a packet from your AI assistant to another person's assistant, or to your own assistant on another computer.

Say "send a packet to anna" and ChatGPT writes a brief (purpose, decisions and their reasons, constraints, next step, references, open questions), attaches the files you choose, and sends the packet to anna's Threadpacket inbox. In her own assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Claude Code) she says "continue the packet from joe" and carries on with the original files. You can ask what packets are waiting for you, whether anna picked up what you sent, revoke a packet you sent, and invite someone to your team.

For families and small teams who use different AI assistants. You need a Threadpacket team: create one at threadpacket.com/join, or join the team that invited you.

Limits: you send only to people in your own team, which has up to 10 people. A packet carries up to 10 files of 25 MiB each: PDF, PNG, JPEG, plain text and Markdown. Packets are deleted after 7 days by default and after 30 days at most. Threadpacket stores what you send as you sent it and runs no AI on it. The other assistant reads it only when its user asks.

positive.description: List what is waiting: two packets from anna and one unsent file
positive.prompt: What packets are waiting for me in Threadpacket?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two packets from anna (School trip forms, with two files; Insurance renewal, brief only) and the unsent file lease.pdf.

positive.description: Continue a packet and use its files
positive.prompt: Continue the packet from anna about the school trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the School trip forms brief, names permission-slip.pdf and packing-list.md, opens the file the next step needs, and does that step.

positive.description: Send a packet to a teammate
positive.prompt: Send a packet to anna: we chose 14 March, she needs to confirm the bus.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm the send, then sends a packet to anna and reports the packet id, the recipient and when it expires.

positive.description: Check whether a teammate picked up a packet
positive.prompt: Did anna pick up the kitchen quote?
positive.expected_behavior: Says anna picked up Kitchen quote, in which assistant, and when.

positive.prompt: Revoke the packet I just sent to anna.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, revokes the packet, and says that content anna already read cannot be recalled.

negative.description: Email is out of scope: Threadpacket does not send email, so no tool is called
Recipient outside the team: bob is not a member, nothing is sent, and the assistant offers to invite him
Another team's data: only the signed-in person's own team is visible
negative.prompt: Show me the packets of the team acme.

review.commerce_description: Threadpacket does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Renamed to Threadpacket: send a packet (brief + original files) to a teammate's assistant, read and continue packets, see pickups, revoke, and invite people.
